board.title: Kitchen board
board.intro: Guest orders land here live — work them from received to delivered without a printer.

empty.allClearHint: New orders appear here the moment a guest places them.
empty.filteredHint: Try clearing a filter or two.
empty.historyHint: Delivered and cancelled orders build the history.

hint.title: How the kitchen board works
hint.body: Orders float to the top when they pass their prep target. Start an order to claim it, mark it out for delivery when it leaves, and Delivered when it reaches the guest. The paid-revenue number counts delivered orders only.

noAccess.title: You don't have access to F&B orders
noAccess.hint: Ask a manager for the fnb orders permission.

cancel.title: Cancel this order?
cancel.note: The guest sees the order as cancelled immediately. This can't be undone.

menus.title: Menus
menus.intro: Build photo menus with sections, prices and availability — guests browse them in their own language.

empty.title: No menus yet
empty.hint: Start with your main menu — In-Room Dining, Pool Bar, Breakfast…

sectionRow.empty: No items in this section yet.

menuModal.windowsHint: Hotel-local times. Overnight windows like 20:00–02:00 work. Leave empty for always available.
menuModal.prepSlaHint: Orders float on the board when they pass this target.
menuModal.pricingHint: Applies to every item unless the item overrides it.

itemModal.priceHint: In your hotel currency. Options carry their own absolute prices.
itemModal.variantHint: One simple group, e.g. Size — Medium 80 / Large 110. Each option has its own full price.
itemModal.notesHint: e.g. “no onions”. Turn off for items where notes make no sense.
itemModal.photoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MB. Shown in the guest menu — good photos sell.
itemModal.photoInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 5 MB.

names.moreLanguagesHint: Guests using these languages see English until you translate.
names.help: Arabic and English are required; other languages fall back to English.

locations.title: Delivery locations
locations.intro: Define where guests can receive orders — pool, beach, lobby — and print QR stickers for each.

empty.title: No locations yet
empty.hint: Guests can always order to their room. Add the pool or beach to turn them into revenue surfaces.

modal.keyHint: Locked once created — printed stickers depend on it. Renaming changes display names only.
modal.spotLabelHint: e.g. Umbrella / Table — appears next to the number.
modal.activeHint: Hiding keeps printed QRs working — guests just pick a location manually.

guidance.title: Zone stickers vs numbered stickers
guidance.body: Print a zone sticker for every location. Use numbered series only for fixed furniture (mounted umbrellas, tables). Movable sunbeds should get the zone sticker — guests type their spot number themselves, because furniture moves and a wrong pre-filled spot is worse than none.

settings.title: Payment methods have moved
settings.body: Cash and room-charge options now live on one hotel-wide settings page — not just for F&B, but for every paid module (Events too).

stayOrders.title: F&B orders
stayOrders.settleNote: This records {amount} of room-charge orders as collected. It can't be undone.
stayOrders.checkoutNote: This stay has {amount} of uncollected room-charge orders. Checking out will mark them as settled — collect the amount first.
